verdict.rationale: Relay offers built-in high-yield savings accounts (up to 3.00% APY) with automated rules to move idle operating cash into savings, all within the same Relay account/institution—no need to move funds elsewhere. Community evidence corroborates that Relay automatically partitions and earns interest on idle funds like tax reserves. missing for 10: independent verification of the actual APY rate over time, comparison to market rates, and details on FDIC insurance/sweep mechanics for the savings feature.
